args.body:
## Summary
- `main` pins `fastjson==2.8.0`, which is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).
- This PR bumps the pin to `fastjson==3.1.0`, the fixed version in the 3.x line. (Per team direction, we stay on 3.x since the fastjson 3.x migration is complete — a 2.9.4 bump was rejected in favor of the 3.x fix.)

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch (sha `13fee7191e`) passed.

Closes CVE-2026-31337 exposure.
